CustomField.description: Name of the file this sheet is written to. As Excel, sheets of the same export with the same File Name are written to one workbook. As CSV, every sheet is its own file, named "File Name - Sheet Label" when the file has more than one sheet. The extension is added, and {date} is replaced with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: File this sheet is written to, e.g. "Accounts {date}". In Excel, sheets sharing a File Name share a workbook.
CustomField.label: File Name
